Measurement-error-corrected inter-region connectivity and PPI via REPAIR

Regularized linear deconvolution of BOLD time series

Diagnose amplitude attenuation and event leakage for a frozen inverse

Estimate HRF shapes from other runs, with optional spatial regularization

function to get interpolated event locked data

Align a set of deconvolved time series files to an event of interest function.
fmri_ts
R6 class representing a multivariate time series object for fMRI analysis
generate_feature
This function creates K shifts of a neural events vector according to the kernel length, K.
generate_feature_armadillo
This function creates K shifts of a neural events vector according to the kernel length, K.
get_medusa_compression_score()
Compute event-locked multivariate PCA compression scores across spatial units
get_medusa_interpolated_ts()
front-end function for taking a list of windowed time series by mask value, interpolating them onto a time grid, and (optionally) averaging across voxels/units within a value to derive the mean interpolated time series
hrf_library()
Build a small, constrained library of causal HRFs
jlmer()

medusa_multilag_infer()
Joint Multi-Lag Trajectory Modeling and Operator-Informed Inference for MEDuSA
meta_mixed_by()
Function to run Bayesian random-effects meta-regression on coefficients from mixed_by
mixed_by()
Mixed by runs a set of mixed-effects models for each combination of a set of factors. Its primary use is to run the same model on different splits of the data.

Read 3D/4D NIfTI runs directly into MEDuSA time-by-voxel matrices

Canonical SPM difference-of-gammas hemodynamic response function

Function to perform voxelwise deconvolution on an fMRI dataset using the fMRI model arguments object
